MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Bluetooth adapter fits my interest in adding useful connections to existing devices, provided it works with my computer.",
    "The cable ties feel useful because my adapters and cables create a practical need to keep connected devices organized."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The memory kits, CPU cooler, and case fans assume an upgrade project I have not shown a need for, and their compatibility with my equipment is uncertain.",
    "A modem, flash drive, and drive enclosure serve different needs from connecting devices; I have no current replacement, storage, or drive-reuse project.",
    "My DVI cable purchase does not establish a need for HDMI, since the connector my equipment uses matters."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any computer component.",
    "Shared USB or networking connections seem to have counted too heavily when the products solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My history points toward specific ways to connect or mount existing equipment, rather than broad hardware upgrades.",
    "I interact infrequently and need a clear immediate use; a related accessory alone is not enough to interest me.",
    "The exact connector and device compatibility matter before I would choose an accessory."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my interest in practical connectivity but stretched it into unsupported upgrade and storage needs."
}
